answer: Tie every claim of identity to something only real time can produce. This chain publishes the seed after the previous close, so a relic of an epoch cannot be minted backwards: no key, no credit, no history exists until that window has actually passed. A mirror is cheap and any clone can raise one, but the network keeps its own copy of the ledger and reads the reflection against what was spent, not what was said. So the attacker must forge the record itself, epoch by epoch, at full cost per seat.
